description: This file contains vendor prefix mixins for CSS properties, used to ensure cross-browser compatibility of CSS features such as animations, transformations, box shadows, and other visual effects. The mixins are deprecated in favor of Autoprefixer. It defines reusable Sass mixins that apply vendor-specific prefixes for key CSS properties relevant to CSS3 animations, transforms, transitions, and other styling features.
